steps.intro: Marketing cabinet. Company, project, and strategy cycle. Sections on the left; context and actions in the header. Use arrow keys or buttons between steps.
steps.toolbar: Header and context: company, project, document, content manager, copy page link, refresh, and the AI job center.
steps.sidebar: Cabinet sections. Switch JTBD, analysis, campaigns, IMC, chat, and more. In compact mode, hover an icon to see its name.
steps.overviewMode: Overview mode shows health cards and narratives. Open the interactive dashboard from the header for a customizable widget grid.
steps.dashboardToolbar: Dashboard toolbar: layout presets, preset search, add widgets, import and export, and keyboard shortcuts — press question mark.
steps.widgetChrome: Tile chrome: title, widget type icon, a help hint on the title, and actions to pin, hide, or remove the tile.
steps.dashboardGrid: Widget grid. Drag and resize tiles. Use the tile menu or right-click to pin, duplicate, or hide.
